post.summary: Update category order and tree structure
post.description: Updates the order of product categories based on a new tree structure. The API validates the tree's integrity and re-orders all categories sequentially, regardless of the 'order' values in the request body.

requestBody.description: A nested JSON structure representing the new category tree. The 'order' values will be re-assigned sequentially by the API.

children.description: Nested children categories. This array is optional.

message.example: Invalid category tree structure. A child's parent_id must match its parent's id, and levels must be sequential.
An error occurred while updating the categories: Something went wrong
